Madame Run, Da Nang, Vietnam
Aug 2026 • Family
On a scale of 1 to 5, I rate restaurants from a personal perspective.

【Location】3
It’s a bit towards the end, but it’s a basic grab, so anywhere is fine.

【Atmosphere】4
It looks stylish and photogenic everywhere. I think the food is nice and clean.

【Cooking】3
None of the dishes are deliciously bad.

【Customer service】3
It was her birthday, but she brought me a neon sign of Happy Birthday. Thank you very much.

【Price Performance】3
It's not that expensive, so you can ask for it with confidence.

【General】3
It's a swanky shop that's also on Michelin. The food is delicious and the atmosphere is good. It's in a lot of books, and it introduces a lot of people. So it is absolutely safe and secure. There are no surprises, but it is a restaurant where you can enjoy food that is sure to be reasonable. I think it's just too safe and not adventurous. I feel like I don't need that lol
